headlines.title: Why Did Lumentum Stock Fall?
headlines.summary: Shares of Lumentum (LITE) fell 25.3% in the five trading sessions from October 9 to October 16, 2026. The S&P 500 lost 1.9% over the same stretch. Although the company's chief executive stated on Friday, October 9, that AI demand had booked capacity through early 2029—lifting the shares 5.2% that session—the slide began the following trading day, Monday, October 12. So what changed between that Friday and the following Monday.

headlines.title: Optics Stocks Rally Ahead of Earnings: Applied Optoelectronics Jumps 5%, Lumentum Adds 4%, Coherent Rises 2%
headlines.summary: Optics stocks are surging ahead of a cluster of November earnings reports, and one CEO's claim that his company cannot meet most customer demand for years has traders wondering whether the AI optical bottleneck is bigger than the market has priced in.

headlines.title: Lumentum (LITE) Can’t Meet Demand. Can Its Valuation Hold Up?
headlines.summary: According to Lumentum Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ:LITE) CEO Michael Hurlston, the company is now almost sold out of components for 2029, as he said in a recent interview. Just six months ago, he said Lumentum was on track to sell out by 2028.

headlines.title: Arm vs. Lumentum: Which Tech Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
headlines.summary: Arm commands premium valuations on its dominant licensing model, while Lumentum trades cheaper despite explosive growth, but faces customer concentration risks.

headlines.title: LITE, CRWV, NBIS, AMAT, SMCI Were Among Last Week’s Biggest AI-Linked Losers: Which Stocks Are Flashing Oversold Signals?
headlines.summary: CoreWeave and Applied Materials enter ‘oversold’ territory after last week’s tech sell-off.

description: Lumentum Holdings Inc. manufactures and sells optical and photonic products in the Americas, the Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. It offers component products, including semiconductor laser chips, laser sub-assemblies, line subsystems, and wavelength management systems. The company also offers system products, such as optical modules, optical circuit switches, and industrial lasers, including short-pulse solid-state lasers and kilowatt-class fiber lasers. Its products and solutions are used in cloud, artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML), telecommunications, consumer, and industrial end-market applications. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
